name: No mutation
lesson: With mutation switched off, crossover can only reshuffle letters the population already has, so a letter that is missing from a position stays missing.
lookFor: In this seed none of the 12 starting strings has an O in position 5. The match rate for position 5 stays at 0% for the whole run, the population collapses to copies of one string by generation 22 (diversity 0), and the best stalls at 3 of 5, short of HELLO.
